title: Parsons' death in a home lab explosion

tellings.quote: In 1952, he died in an explosion in his home laboratory. Officially, it was ruled an accident involving volatile chemicals. But, some found the circumstances suspicious.

plain: In 1952 the rocket scientist Jack Parsons died in an explosion in his home laboratory in Pasadena, which was officially ruled an accident with volatile chemicals, though some found the circumstances suspicious. Michels tells this himself, without naming who those doubters were. The story is told because, if the death was no accident, it would cast a shadow over an early pioneer of American rocketry.
